RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL  ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Friday, the March 10, 2006/Phalguna 19, 1927 (Saka)
————
(Ministries: Agriculture; Chemicals and Fertilizers; Consumer Affairs; Food
and Public Distribution; Environment and Forests; Food Processing Industries;
Health and Family Welfare; Railways; Steel)
Total number of questions — 20
National policy on land use
*281. SHRI PYARELAL KHAN-
DELWAL: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE  be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that there is no
national policy on land use in our country;
(b) whether it is also a fact that the soil
Management Techniques like nutrient
buffer power concept are not adequately
recognised in the country;
(c) if so, the reasons therefor and how it
affects our foodgrain output;
(d) if not, the details thereof including
the details regarding the change of
agricultural land use;
(e) whether China has harvested more
than 550 million tonnes of foodgrain
compared to our 200 million tonnes of
foodgrain by using abovesaid techniques;
and
(f) if so, the comparative study thereof?
Cleanliness in Government Hospitals
*282. SHRI E. M. SUDARSANA
NATCHIAPPAN: Will the Minister of
HEALTH AND FAMILY WELFARE   be
pleased to state:
(a) whether any fresh initiatives have
been taken by Government to improve the
cleanliness level in various Government
hospitals where the situation is dismal;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) if not, the reasons therefor?
FPI in Nagaland
*283. SHRI T. R. ZELIANG: Will the
Minister of  FOOD PROCESSING
INDUSTRIES  be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have received
any proposal to develop and promote food
processing industries in Nagaland;
(b) if so, the details of steps taken to
implement this proposal; and
(c) if not, what allocation has been made
for the State during the last three years?

88
Leasing out of forest land in Kerala
*284. SHRI N. K. PREMA-
CHANDRAN: Will the Minister of
ENVIRONMENT AND FORESTS  be
pleased to state:
(a) the extent of forest land leased out
in Kerala for a period beyond two years
against the provisions of Forest
Conservation Act, 1980 and purposes for
which such land lease has been made;
(b) whether the Government of Kerala
renewed the above leases without attracting
the provisions of Forest Conservation Act
and whether the State Government sought
the permission of the Central Government
for the renewal of lease of forest land which
stands leased out to various purposes; and
(c) how many lease cases have been
signed on or before the expiry of lease
period and transferred to other holders
violating the provisions of FCA in Kerala
and the details of such cases with extent
and district-wise statistics thereof?
Increasing forest cover
*285. SHRI SANJAY RAUT: Will the
Minister of  ENVIRONMENT AND
FORESTS  be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have made any
comprehensive strategic plan for increasing
the forest cover by maintaining greenery in
the country for the next twenty years;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) what steps have been taken or
proposed to be taken for increasing forest
cover in the country;
(d) the estimated amount to be spent
on this plan and whether Government have
chalked out any plan for the increasing
participation of local people in these plans;
and
(e) if so, the details thereof?
Disbursement of subsidies to BPL,
poor and marginal farmers
*286. SHRI VIJAY J. DARDA: Will
the Minister of  CONSUMER AFFAIRS,
FOOD AND PUBLIC DISTRIBUTION
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that main
recipients of subsidy are surplus producing
farmers of five States from where
procurement is done at the prices set by
Government;
(b) if so, whether the disbursal of subsidy
can be improved with a view to ensuring
that BPL consumers/small and marginal
farmers get the intended benefit of subsidies;
if not, the reasons therefor; and
(c) whether the modern Information
Technology could be harnessed to achieve
disbursement of subsidies for the BPL,
poor and marginal consumers?
Production of Basmati rice in
India and Pakistan
*287. SHRI RAJKUMAR DHOOT:
Will the Minister of  AGRICULTURE  be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Pakistan has
succeeded in acquiring favourable position
in the battle of Basmati rice;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the steps taken by Government to
regain its supermacy in the production of
Indian Basmati?

Consumer Helpline
*288. SHRI N. R. GOVINDARAJAR:
Will the Minister of  CONSUMER
AFFAIRS, FOOD AND PUBLIC
DISTRIBUTION  be pleased to state:
(a) whether a National Consumer
Helpline has been set up to provide help,
information and counselling to the
consumers on the matters relating to their
exploitation;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether Government propose to
provide assistance to the State
Governments to start such help lines at all
district levels; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Survey of wildlife in Papikonda Game
Sanctuary
*289. SHRI S. M. LALJAN BASHA:
Will the Minister of  ENVIRONMENT
AND FORESTS  be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that there were
repeated demands from environmentalists
in West Godavari of Andhra Pradesh for a
proper survey of the wildlife in Papikonda
Game Sanctuary;
(b) if so, the details of these demands
and when they were made;
(c) whether it is also a fact that
Government refused to entertain such
legitimate demands;
(d) what steps Government would take
to review such refusals ; and
(e) whether such funds meant for
surveys have been spent on foreign travel
by the officials?
Spurious seeds, fertilizers, etc.
*290. DR. GYAN PRAKASH
PILANIA: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE   be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware that
substandard/spurious/fake inputs for farming,
namely, seeds, fertilizers, insecticides,
pesticides, etc., are galore in the market, which
affect adversely the farming community;
(b) if so, the action taken against the
culprits/cheats/adulterators pseudo
manufacturers, etc.;
(c) the punitive and preventive steps
Government contemplate to take to check
the menance;
(d) whether farmers are complaining
that seed corporations at the Centre and
States have failed to supply at fixed price,
standard/genuine hallmarked seeds of
various crops to them; and
(e) if so, the corrective action being
taken, as seeds are primary input for
agriculture?
Control of commensal monkeys
*291. SHRI RAVULA CHANDRA
SEKAR REDDY: Will the Minister of
ENVIRONMENT AND FORESTS  be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are
contemplating any action plan for control
of commensal monkeys in conflict
situations;
(b) if so, whether any workshop has
been held recently with the experts for this
purpose; and
(c) if so, the details thereof and the
outcome thereof?

Passenger facilities at Buxar station
†*292. SHRI BASHISTHA NARAIN
SINGH: Will the Minister of  RAILWAYS
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that hundreds
and thousands of passengers from Bihar
and Uttar Pradesh travel to and from Buxar
railway station everyday;
(b) if so, whether it is also a fact that
Railways earns a large amount of revenue
from Buxar, but still there is no retiring
facility available there which is causing lot
of inconvenience to the upper class
passengers;
(c) if so, action being taken for
expansion of proper facility to passengers
at the railway station;
(d) whether there is any plan for halting
the Rajdhani Express and other super fast
trains thereat in view of the large number
of upper class passengers travelling from
Buxar railway station; and
(e) if so, by when it is proposed to be
implemented?
Import of vaccine from China
†*293. SHRI JANESHWAR
MISHRA: Will the Minister of  HEALTH
AND FAMILY WELFARE   be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Government have taken a
decision to import vaccines from China for
prevention of encephalitis spreading in
some States of the country;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) by when these imported vaccines
would reach the affected States;
(d) whether Government have taken any
measures for developing such vaccines in
the country; and
(e) if so, the details thereof?
Modernisation of fishing harbours
*294. SHRI NANDI YELLAIAH: Will
the Minister of  AGRICULTURE  be
pleased to state:
(a) the status of the proposals submitted
by the Government of Andhra Pradesh for
modernization/renovation of fishing
harbours, indicating the estimated cost
involved in each proposal;
(b) the details of the progress made, so
far, on the modernization projects
sanctioned for Visakhapatnam, Kakinada,
Nizampura and Machlipatnam based
fisheries in the State; and
(c) the steps being taken/already taken
by Government and various States for
further strengthening the fishery industry
in the country?
Closing down of Kudremukh Iron Ore
Company Limited
*295. SHRI K. B. KRISHNA
MURTHY: Will the Minister of  STEEL
be pleased to state:
(a) when the Kudremukh Iron Ore
Company Limited was closed down;
(b) the number of employees who lost
their jobs;
(c) whether there is any request from
the Karnataka Government to continue
mining operations at Kudremukh; and
(d) the steps, if any, taken to rehabilitate
the employees of KIOCL?

Overbridges/underbridges in
Jharkhand
†*296. SHRI AJAY MAROO: Will the
Minister of  RAILWAYS  be pleased to
state:
(a) the details of flyovers/underbridges
under construction in Jharkhand;
(b) the details of proposals submitted
by the Government of Jharkhand for
construction of flyovers/underbridges on
railway crossings;
(c) the details of steps taken by
Government thereto; and
(d) whether the State Government have
itself borne half of the expenditure incurred
on the same; and
(e) if so, the details of the amount
thereof?
Delhi-Lahore Samjhauta Express
*297. KUMARI NIRMALA
DESHPANDE: Will the Minister of
RAILWAYS  be pleased to state:
(a) whether the condition of Delhi-
Lahore Samjhauta Express is far from
satisfactory;
(b) whether it is a fact that no facilities
are available to passengers at Attari station;
(c) if so, what steps are being planned
to make this travel more comfortable;
(d) whether it is also a fact that
passengers have to wait for hours at Attari
and Wagha;
(e) whether this time can be reduced;
and
(f) if not, the reasons therefor?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Strengthening of public health
services in Uttaranchal
*298. SHRI HARISH RAWAT: Will the
Minister of  HEALTH AND FAMILY
WELFARE  be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have any
proposal to improve the standard and
functioning of the Central/State
Government hospitals, primary health
centres and community health centres set
up in the rural areas of the country specially
in hilly and backward areas of Uttaranchal;
and
(b) if so, the details thereof?
Resolution against two-child norm
*299. SHRI RAMA MUNI REDDY
SIRIGIREDDY: Will the Minister of
HEALTH AND FAMILY WELFARE  be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that a meeting of
the reconstituted National Commission on
Population was held recently;
(b) whether it is also a fact that there
was a resolution against implementation of
two-child norm in the country; and
(c) if so, the reasons for implementing
two-child norm by Government?
Procurement in NER
*300. SHRIMATI SYEDA ANWARA
TAIMUR : Will the Minister of  CONSUMER
AFFAIRS, FOOD AND PUBLIC
DISTRIBUTION be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that there is huge
leakage and diversion of Wheat and Rice
meant for the Public Distribution System
in most of the North-Eastern States;

(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether Government have taken any
decision for procuring foodgrains locally
to be distributed under the public
distribution system and not to bring from
outside of the North Eastern States so that
local farmers get good support price for
their produce;
(d) if so, the details thereof; and
(e) the steps initiated by Government
to increase storage capacity in the region?
